overview: The discussion focused on reviewing Design Option D 2.1 for the Medford High School building project, which proposes constructing a new school building on Edgerly Field.

items.title: Design Option D 2.1 - MHS Building Project
items.summary: Jenny Graham and Matt Rice reviewed the layout of Option D 2.1, noting its elevated and remote placement on Edgerly Field, the detached pool location, the avoidance of modular classrooms, and potential parking and field configurations.

subject: High School Design Option D 2.1 Review
